title: Enquirer’s Guide: What is the Eidetic Stratum?
summary: It is an underlying order that sometimes leaves measurable effects in our world and can be reached through carefully made openings.
author: The Enquirer’s Guide Desk
paragraphs: This entry from The Enquirer’s Guide answers a question often put to the Society: “What is the Eidetic Stratum?”
It is an underlying order that sometimes leaves measurable effects in our world and can be reached through carefully made openings.
We can study it, bring things back from it, and exchange signals through it. Whether it lies beneath our world, mirrors it, or helps give it form remains unsettled.

Readers should treat the answer as an introduction rather than a final authority. Eidetic science in Alderwick is reported through measurements, disputed interpretations and careful revisions, and a respectable enquiry may properly end with further questions.
